cases.sentence: Он послал ветер на ___, и воды стали убывать.
cases.translation: He sent a wind over the earth, and the waters began to recede.
cases.explain: The preposition на expressing motion takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: The rain stopped falling from the sky.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: The ark rested on the mountains of Ararat.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case (plural).

cases.sentence: Голубь не нашёл сухого места и вернулся к ___ в ковчег.
cases.translation: The dove found no dry place and returned to Noah into the ark.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward/to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Выйди из ___ и ты, и твоя жена.
cases.translation: Come out of the ark, you and your wife.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Ной построил ___ жертвенник и принёс жертвы.
cases.translation: Noah built an altar to the Lord and offered sacrifices.
cases.explain: The dative case marks the indirect object (the recipient 'to the Lord').

cases.sentence: Никогда впредь не стану я проклинать землю из-за ___.
cases.translation: Never again will I curse the ground because of man.
cases.explain: The preposition из-за (because of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Потом Ной выпустил ___, чтобы увидеть, сошла ли вода.
cases.translation: Then Noah sent out a dove to see whether the water had gone down.
cases.explain: The transitive verb выпустил (sent out) takes a direct object; for an animate masculine noun the accusative equals the genitive form.

reading.ru: На семнадцатый день седьмого месяца ковчег остановился на Араратских горах.
reading.question: Where did the ark come to rest?
reading.explain: The text says the ark rested on the mountains of Ararat.

reading.ru: Когда вечером голубь вернулся, в клюве у него был свежесорванный масличный лист.
reading.question: What did the dove bring back in its beak?
reading.explain: The text says the dove returned in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf in its beak.

reading.ru: Он подождал ещё семь дней и снова выпустил голубя, и на этот раз голубь не вернулся.
reading.question: What happened after Noah sent the dove out the last time?
options: The dove brought an olive leaf
reading.explain: The text says that this time the dove did not come back.

reading.ru: Ной построил Господу жертвенник и принёс на нём жертвы всесожжения из всех видов чистых животных и птиц.
reading.question: What did Noah do after leaving the ark?
options: He built an altar and offered burnt offerings
reading.correct: He built an altar and offered burnt offerings
reading.explain: The text says Noah built an altar to the Lord and offered burnt offerings on it.

reading.ru: Через сорок дней Ной открыл окно, которое он сделал в ковчеге, и выпустил ворона, и тот улетал и прилетал обратно до тех пор, пока вода на земле не высохла.
reading.question: Which bird did Noah send out first?
reading.explain: The text says Noah first sent out a raven, which flew back and forth until the water dried up.

reading.ru: Тогда Ной понял, что вода сошла с земли.
reading.question: What did the olive leaf show Noah?
options: That the water had receded from the earth
reading.correct: That the water had receded from the earth
reading.explain: The text says Noah then understood that the water had gone down from the earth.
